articles.title: Rays beat Red Sox in home finale, head to New York seeking AL East title
articles.description: Sunday’s win is their franchise-most 55th in a season at Tropicana Field and is decided early with a four-run first inning.

articles.title: Richie Palacios delivers in 9th, ‘relentless’ Rays win another walkoff
articles.description: Palacios bloops a single to shallow rightfield to score Junior Caminero with the decisive run against the Red Sox.

articles.title: Junior Caminero becomes first Ray to win back-to-back team MVP awards
articles.description: Notes | Four Rays had won the award multiple times but never in consecutive seasons until the 23-year-old third baseman did so Saturday.

articles.title: Of the 25 players the Rays have added, who’s had the biggest impact?
articles.description: Tales | From the large group, there are several that have played major roles in the team’s success this season.

articles.title: As Rays seek to clinch AL East title, Junior Caminero eyes MVP award
articles.description: Houston’s Yordan Alvarez has been the frontrunner for most of the season, but Tampa Bay’s third baseman is making it an interesting race.

articles.title: A walk with Ken Babby through the Battery provides peek at Rays’ future
articles.description: The CEO shares what elements from the Atlanta Braves’ complex will be part of their Tampa site, as well as what the team plans to be bigger and better.

articles.title: After racing through minors, Caden Bodine gets a weekend stay with Rays
articles.description: Notes | Though only on the taxi squad, the 22-year-old catcher gets a chance to become familiar with the big-league game, routine and players.

articles.title: Rays don’t have much go right in streak-snapping loss to Red Sox
articles.description: Ian Seymour gives up four runs in the first three innings, and that’s too much of a hole even though his teammates draw eight walks.

articles.title: Rays team with Yankees-affiliated Legends Global to handle sales
articles.description: Legends Global will handle naming rights, sponsorships and suites/premium seating for the Tampa ballpark. The firm also will serve as the owners’ rep on construction matters.

articles.title: Taylor Walls is a welcome sight back in the lineup after a hip scare
articles.description: Notes | The Rays shortstop returns after a relatively short stint on the injured list with a hip flexor strain.

articles.title: Rays beat A’s, extend AL East lead over Yankees, then hug it out
articles.description: Two runs in each of the first 2 innings and a solid day on the mound is enough for a 5th straight win and 4 ½-game division cushion.

articles.title: Rays’ Drew Rasmussen, Athletics’ Jeffrey Springs excited about matchup
articles.description: Notes | After a number of shared experiences in Tampa Bay, the two pitchers have remained close and will be opposing starters for Thursday’s series finale.

articles.title: Tampa Sports Authority chosen to review Rays ballpark design plan
articles.description: Hillsborough Commissioner Joshua Wostal raised concern about approving money before other legal agreements are approved by the county.

articles.title: Junior Caminero does it again, delivers walkoff homer to beat A’s
articles.description: The Rays get the second walkoff homer in less than a week from their All-Star infielder.

articles.title: Rays lose another reliever with Tyler Wells out, get Jake Fraley back
articles.description: Notes | The trade-deadline acquisition, sidelined by forearm tightness, is optimistic about returning in time for the playoffs.

articles.title: For Rays slugger Junior Caminero, the swing is the thing in his success
articles.description: How does he hit 40 homers a year? The majors’ highest average bat speed and one of the flattest swings positions him well.

articles.title: Cedric Mullins is the Rays’ nominee for MLB’s Roberto Clemente Award
articles.description: Notes | The prestigious MLB-wide honor goes annually to a player who shows good character, community involvement and philanthropy, among other traits.

articles.title: Victor Mesa Jr. stepped in, up for Rays. They’re glad he did
articles.description: Lacking a clear role when he was acquired in the spring, the outfielder has become indispensable. Monday, he won player of the week honors.

articles.title: Hard-throwing Brody Hopkins excited after major-league debut with Rays
articles.description: Notes | A tough start to the season and an August shift to relief work led to the righty’s big-league debut on Sunday.

articles.title: Rays sweep Astros to cap good week, feel they have shot to ‘take it all’
articles.description: After throwing 5 no-hit innings, Freddy Peralta talks confidently about a Tampa Bay team that hits 4 homers in win No. 90.
